schedule.league: League the match belongs to, one of `mlv`, `lovb` or `aupvb`.
schedule.season: Season the match was played in.
schedule.match_id: Volleystation match identifier, and the join key across all nine datasets.
schedule.parent_match_id: For a golden set, the match it decided.
schedule.game_type: `regular season`, `semi-final`, `final` and so on. AU also uses `preseason` and `exhibition`. LOVB and AU use `golden set`.
schedule.venue_name: Arena the match was played in.
schedule.home_team_name: Name of the home team at the time of the match.
schedule.away_team_name: Name of the away team at the time of the match.
schedule.home_team_set_wins: Sets won by the home team.
schedule.away_team_set_wins: Sets won by the away team.
schedule.is_neutral_site: True when neither team was hosting.
schedule.status: `completed` for a match that has been played, `scheduled` for a published fixture that hasn't.

sets.season: Season the match was played in.
sets.team_name: Name of the team this row belongs to.
sets.zone_1: Player id starting the set in zone 1, the serving position in the back right.
sets.zone_2: Player id starting the set in zone 2, front right.
sets.zone_3: Player id starting the set in zone 3, front middle.
sets.zone_4: Player id starting the set in zone 4, front left.
sets.zone_5: Player id starting the set in zone 5, back left.
sets.zone_6: Player id starting the set in zone 6, back middle.
sets.points_scored: Points this team scored in the set.
sets.served_first: True if this team served the opening point of the set.
sets.started_left: True if this team began the set on the left of the court.

officials.season: Season the match was played in.
officials.official_level: Certification level as published, such as a national federation code.

player_info.season: Season the match was played in.
player_info.team_name: Name of the team this player was rostered to for the match.
player_info.team_short_name: Abbreviated team name, typically three letters.
player_info.player_id: Volleystation player identifier, stable across matches and seasons within a league.
player_info.primary_position: Listed role, one of `libero`, `outside hitter`, `opposite`, `middle blocker` or `setter`.
player_info.is_foreign: True if the source flagged the player as foreign for this competition.
player_info.is_captain: True if the player wore the captain's armband for this match.
player_info.is_libero: True if the player was registered as a libero for this match.
player_info.roster_status: `active` for the match roster, `reserve` for a registered player not on it.

team_staff.season: Season the match was played in.
team_staff.team_name: Name of the team this staff member worked for.

pbp.season: Season the match was played in.
pbp.play_number: Touch within the rally. Sort on set, rally and play together to get chronological order.
pbp.team_side: `home` or `away`, for the team making the touch.
pbp.player_id: Volleystation identifier of the player making the touch.
pbp.jersey_number: Number worn by the player making the touch.
pbp.effect_code: How the touch came off, in DataVolley grades. `#` is a terminal winner, `+` good, `!` neutral, `-` poor, `/` a blocked attack or overpass, `=` an error.
pbp.point_winner: `home` or `away`, the side that won the rally this touch belongs to. Identical on every touch of a rally.
pbp.home_score: Home score after the rally this touch belongs to.
pbp.away_score: Away score after the rally this touch belongs to.
pbp.serve_speed_ms: Serve speed in metres per second. Only ever recorded by MLV, and only on a fraction of a percent of touches.

events_log.season: Season the match was played in.
events_log.event_type: What happened: `rally`, `libero`, `substitution`, `timeout`, `technicalTimeout`, `videoChallenge`, `newLibero`, `sanction` and more. Columns that don't apply to an event type are null on that row.
events_log.event_end_time: When the event ended. Populated for rallies and video challenges.
events_log.team_side: `home` or `away`, for the team the event belongs to.
events_log.player_id: Player the event concerns, for events about one player.
events_log.jersey_number: Jersey number of the player the event concerns.
events_log.player_in_id: Player coming onto the court, on a substitution or libero swap.
events_log.player_in_jersey_number: Jersey number of the player coming on.
events_log.player_out_id: Player leaving the court, on a substitution or libero swap.
events_log.player_out_jersey_number: Jersey number of the player going off.
events_log.staff_type: Role of the staff member sanctioned, on a sanction event.
events_log.is_verified: True if the rally was verified by the scorer.
events_log.is_super_point: True if the rally was scored as a super point.
events_log.super_point_team: Team awarded the super point. Only ever populated for LOVB.
events_log.is_libero: True if the player the event concerns was the libero.
events_log.is_exceptional_substitution: True if a substitution was made outside the normal allowance, such as for an injury.
events_log.is_approved: Whether a request was granted, on a technical timeout.
events_log.sanction_type: Severity of a sanction, such as `warning`.
events_log.challenge_reason: What a video challenge was called for, such as `netTouch` or `ballIn`.
events_log.challenge_score_change: How the score was adjusted as a result of the challenge.
events_log.challenge_requested_time: When the challenge was requested, as distinct from when it was reviewed.
events_log.home_score: Home score at the time of the event, on events that carry one.
events_log.away_score: Away score at the time of the event, on events that carry one.

player_boxscore.season: Season the match was played in.
player_boxscore.team_name: Name of the team this player played for.
player_boxscore.is_captain: True if the player wore the captain's armband.
player_boxscore.is_libero: True if the player was registered as a libero.
player_boxscore.sets_played: Sets this player appeared in across the match.
player_boxscore.set_number: Set this row's stats belong to.
player_boxscore.starting_position: Court zone the player started the set in, blank if they didn't start it.
player_boxscore.serve_errors: Serves that went out, into the net, or were otherwise faulted.
player_boxscore.serve_aces: Serves that won the point outright.
player_boxscore.serve_efficiency: Serve efficiency as published by the source.
player_boxscore.attack_errors: Attacks that went out, into the net, or were blocked for a point.
player_boxscore.attack_kills: Attacks that won the point outright.
player_boxscore.attack_kill_ratio: Kills as a share of attempts.
player_boxscore.attack_efficiency: Attack efficiency, as published by the source.
player_boxscore.reception_errors: Receptions that gave up the point.
player_boxscore.positive_reception_ratio: Share of receptions graded positive or better.
player_boxscore.block_points: Blocks that won the point outright.
player_boxscore.block_touches: Blocks that touched the ball without ending the rally.
player_boxscore.assists: Sets that led directly to a kill.
player_boxscore.earned_points: Points the player earned themselves: kills, aces and block points.
player_boxscore.points_scored: Total points credited to the player, including points won on opponent errors.

team_boxscore.season: Season the match was played in.
team_boxscore.team_name: Name of the team this row belongs to.
team_boxscore.set_number: Set this row's stats belong to.
team_boxscore.serve_errors: Serves that went out, into the net, or were otherwise faulted.
team_boxscore.serve_aces: Serves that won the point outright.
team_boxscore.serve_efficiency: Serve efficiency as published by the source.
team_boxscore.attack_errors: Attacks that went out, into the net, or were blocked for a point.
team_boxscore.attack_kills: Attacks that won the point outright.
team_boxscore.attack_kill_ratio: Kills as a share of attempts.
team_boxscore.attack_efficiency: Attack efficiency, as published by the source.
team_boxscore.reception_errors: Receptions that gave up the point.
team_boxscore.positive_reception_ratio: Share of receptions graded positive or better.
team_boxscore.block_points: Blocks that won the point outright.
team_boxscore.block_touches: Blocks that touched the ball without ending the rally.
team_boxscore.assists: Sets that led directly to a kill.
team_boxscore.earned_points: Points the team earned itself: kills, aces and block points.
team_boxscore.points_scored: Total points credited to the team, including points won on opponent errors.
